certification.name: Tenable One OT Exposure Specialist
certification.description: Specialist certification for the Tenable One OT Exposure product. Requires a proctored written exam (60 multiple-choice questions, 120 minutes) and then a practical exam (up to 30 tasks, 240 minutes), each with an 80% pass mark; recertification repeats both exams.
certification.currency_note: Written exam $215 plus practical exam $325, or $540 as a bundle
